location.title: Discover Carcès and the heart of Provence
location.subtitle: Tucked away in the heart of southern France
location.body: La Maison Des Trois Garçons is set in Carcès, a charming Provençal village in the Var. From the house, it’s easy to explore the countryside, vineyards, local markets and characterful villages of Provence. The ideal base for a relaxing holiday in southern France, with plenty of sights and activities nearby.
